description: Opens the instructive inline editing modal directly over highlighted code or generates net-new code at cursor.
rationale: Ctrl+I (Cmd+I) is the primary inline instruction shortcut in Antigravity for localized, in-place edits and refactoring.

description: Accepts full inline AI code suggestion, navigates to the predicted jump point, or auto-inserts missing imports.
rationale: Tab routes next-intent prediction: autocomplete suggestions, larger Supercomplete diffs, and Tab-to-Jump navigation.

description: Partially accepts an inline suggestion token by token instead of committing the entire multi-line block.
rationale: Use Ctrl+Right Arrow (Cmd+Right Arrow) when you only want the beginning of an AI completion.

description: Cancels current active AI autocomplete suggestion or closes the active inline command dialog.
rationale: Escape universally dismisses transient AI overlays, floating supercomplete widgets, and inline edit inputs.

action: Trigger Target Actions via Inline Code Lenses
description: Clickable action buttons appearing above functions and classes for instant 'Explain', 'Refactor', or 'Write Tests'.
rationale: Code Lenses are contextual in-editor triggers placed directly above code symbols for one-click agent operations.

action: Navigate to Next Diff Chunk in Agent Review
description: Jumps between proposed additions/deletions in the inline red/green visual diff review overlay.
rationale: Visual Diff Overlays inside the editor canvas let you inspect, jump between chunks, and selectively accept changes.

description: Focuses the primary Antigravity chat input pane to ask architectural questions, review code, or delegate tasks.
rationale: Ctrl+L (Cmd+L) immediately toggles or places your cursor inside the agent conversation panel.

action: Start a New Chat Session / Conversation
description: Wipes conversational state and spins up a pristine, fresh context window for a brand-new task or inquiry.
rationale: Ctrl+N (Cmd+N) creates an isolated conversation branch, keeping context clean and tokens focused.

description: Expands or collapses the side panel displaying active background subagents, task logs, terminals, and artifacts.
rationale: Ctrl+Shift+L (Cmd+Shift+L) opens the auxiliary sidecar where background jobs and artifact reports reside.

description: Instructs the agent to pause, draft an implementation plan artifact, and await user approval before editing files.
rationale: /plan is the command to ensure deep architectural alignment and plan approval before writing code.

description: Directs the agent to run continuously in an autonomous loop until the objective is 100% verified and achieved.
rationale: /goal triggers long-running autonomous execution without premature stoppage or unnecessary check-ins.

action: Set Recurring Cron Job or Delayed Timer
description: Schedules a one-shot notification timer or 5-field cron expression to monitor deployments or run routines.
rationale: /schedule configures background recurring heartbeats or reminders for the agent.

description: Causes the agent to aggressively interview the developer with targeted questions to resolve ambiguities.
rationale: /grill-me is used when you want the agent to interrogate you on trade-offs before locking in a spec.

action: Capture & Persist Solution to Custom Rules
description: Distills a newly discovered debugging fix or workflow resolution into permanent workspace rules or skills.
rationale: /learn tells the agent to extract the lesson from the current trajectory and persist it for future sessions.

description: Clears visual transcript clutter from the active chat panel while maintaining agent trajectory memory.
rationale: /clear resets the visual chat interface for a tidy workspace.

description: Pulls up the contextual attachment picker to reference files, symbols, docs, terminals, and subagents.
rationale: Typing @ anywhere in prompt input opens the context ingestion popup.

action: Attach Specific File Context to Prompt
description: Feeds the exact contents and path of a local project file directly into the model's context window.
rationale: @file (or @<filename>) pins a specific file as ground truth for code generation.

description: Explicitly binds an external MCP server capability or resource into the agent invocation.
rationale: @tool or @mcp directs the model to prioritize a registered MCP extension.

action: Attach Active Terminal Output to Context
description: Captures standard output, error traces, and active logs from the integrated terminal directly into prompt.
rationale: @terminal allows the AI to immediately see error stacks without manual copy-pasting.

description: Spins up the interactive terminal-based Antigravity developer shell from bash, PowerShell, or zsh.
rationale: The 'agy' binary command is the core terminal executable for headless or shell-based agent workflows.

description: Immediately and cleanly disconnects from the interactive CLI session back to standard terminal prompt.
rationale: Double Ctrl+D is the universal fast terminal escape sequence in the agy CLI.

action: Text Command to Terminate CLI Session
description: Gracefully quits the agy command-line environment and saves execution state.
rationale: Typing /exit or /quit inside agy terminal cleanly exits the session.

action: Display All CLI Subcommands and Flags
description: Prints full usage syntax, subcommands, model flags, and customization options for the Antigravity CLI.
rationale: agy --help lists all available options, parameters, and global commands.

description: Toggles the bottom integrated PowerShell, Command Prompt, or bash terminal panel inside the IDE.
rationale: Ctrl+` (Cmd+`) is the standard shortcut to show or hide the terminal pane.

description: Instantly searches and opens any file across the workspace by typing its relative name or fuzzy match.
rationale: Ctrl+P (Cmd+P) launches fuzzy file finder navigation.

description: Accesses every IDE command, agent setting, extension action, and configuration option.
rationale: Ctrl+Shift+P (Cmd+Shift+P) launches the universal Command Palette.

description: Divides active editor into two horizontal or vertical columns for comparative viewing and coding.
rationale: Ctrl+\ (Cmd+\) splits the editor layout into multiple active panes.

description: Shows or hides the main left navigation bar (File Explorer, Git Source Control, Extensions).
rationale: Ctrl+B (Cmd+B) maximizes editor workspace by toggling the primary sidebar.

description: Performs regex or literal text pattern search across every indexed file and folder in the project.
rationale: Ctrl+Shift+F (Cmd+Shift+F) opens the global search and replace drawer.

description: Immediately navigates the active editor directly to where a function, variable, or class is declared.
rationale: F12 jumps directly to source definition across the language server.
